context.geography: China excludes Hong Kong; Macau is separately identified by the sources. BEA Europe is broader than EU27 and includes the UK, Switzerland, Russia and other non-EU countries. Eurostat uses fixed EU27_2020 membership, excluding the UK.
context.interpretation: Company counts, affiliate entities and branch locations are distinct. U.S. parents and ultimately EU-controlled enterprises are not matched ownership populations; BEA and Eurostat levels must not be used to rank otherwise comparable business presence.
context.question: How has the business presence linking the United States, China and Europe changed?
context.release_timing: As checked October 22, 2026, BEA's latest activity release covers 2023. The published schedule puts the 2024 activity release on November 20, 2026; no 2024 value is inferred.
context.rights: Publish aggregate statistics and original charts only; raw workbooks and reports remain local. Sources and retrieval checksums accompany every observation.

bea_affiliates:china.label: China
bea_affiliates:china.notes: Entities, not unique parent companies, offices or storefronts. U.S. parents are U.S.-resident, not necessarily ultimately U.S.-owned. Includes holding companies. Nonbank coverage before 2009; reporting cutoffs $7m through 2003, $10m in 2004-2008, $25m from 2009. Counts exclude benchmark-exempt affiliates. Lines break at benchmark regimes.
bea_affiliates:china.scope: Foreign affiliates in mainland China, excluding Hong Kong and Macau; combined U.S.-parent ownership over 50%

bea_affiliates:europe.label: Europe
bea_affiliates:europe.notes: Entities, not unique parent companies, offices or storefronts. U.S. parents are U.S.-resident, not necessarily ultimately U.S.-owned. Includes holding companies. Nonbank coverage before 2009; reporting cutoffs $7m through 2003, $10m in 2004-2008, $25m from 2009. Counts exclude benchmark-exempt affiliates. Lines break at benchmark regimes.
bea_affiliates:europe.scope: Foreign affiliates in BEA-defined Europe, not EU27; combined U.S.-parent ownership over 50%

bea_parents:china.label: China
bea_parents:china.notes: Benchmark observations only, not an annual census. A parent is counted once per host country/region, but can appear in both China and Europe: never add these counts. Country attribution and reporting exclusions follow each benchmark. Not restricted to ultimately American-owned companies. Do not substitute majority-owned affiliate counts for parent counts.
bea_parents:china.scope: Distinct U.S.-resident parent companies with affiliates in China; at least 10% foreign-affiliate ownership; BEA reporting exclusions apply

bea_parents:europe.label: Europe
bea_parents:europe.notes: Benchmark observations only, not an annual census. A parent is counted once per host country/region, but can appear in both China and Europe: never add these counts. Country attribution and reporting exclusions follow each benchmark. Not restricted to ultimately American-owned companies. Do not substitute majority-owned affiliate counts for parent counts.
bea_parents:europe.scope: Distinct U.S.-resident parent companies with affiliates in Europe; at least 10% foreign-affiliate ownership; BEA reporting exclusions apply

eurostat_affiliates:china.label: EU27-controlled affiliates
eurostat_affiliates:china.notes: Eurostat enterprise units, not unique European parents or all Europe. Macao is a separate partner. Not matched to BEA's size cutoff, U.S.-resident parent basis or consolidation. EBS methodology changes from 2021; do not join across that boundary or treat confidential cells as zero.
eurostat_affiliates:china.scope: China except Hong Kong; ultimately controlled from fixed EU27_2020 membership, excluding the UK; market producers NACE B-S except O
